description: Contact-center transcripts with the intent and cancellation risk a careful human would assign, per the definitions in lib/ai/prompts.ts. A list of values means any of them is correct.

cases.note: Straightforward quote request
cases.transcript:
Agent: Thanks for calling, how can I help?
Customer: Hi, I'd like a quote for monthly pest control. We just bought a house.
Agent: Happy to help, I'll get someone to call you with pricing.

cases.note: Simple reschedule
cases.transcript:
Agent: Good morning!
Customer: Hi, I have a lawn appointment Thursday, can we move it to Friday instead?
Agent: Sure, Friday at 10 works.
Customer: Perfect, thanks.

cases.note: Angry, explicit cancellation
cases.transcript:
Agent: How can I help today?
Customer: I want to cancel. Your tech tracked mud through my house and nobody called me back. I'm done.
Agent: I'm so sorry. Can I have a manager call you?
Customer: No. Just cancel the plan today.

cases.note: Unhappy but not leaving
cases.transcript:
Agent: What can I do for you?
Customer: The ants came back two days after the treatment. I'm pretty disappointed.
Agent: I'm sorry, we'll send someone back at no charge.
Customer: Okay, thank you, that works.

cases.note: Cancels one appointment but keeps the plan: this is a reschedule, not a cancellation
cases.transcript:
Agent: Thanks for calling.
Customer: I need to cancel tomorrow's visit, I'll be out of town. Can we do next week?
Agent: Of course, how about Tuesday?
Customer: Tuesday's great. Keep my plan as is.

cases.note: Not cancelling yet but comparing a cheaper competitor: medium risk
cases.transcript:
Agent: How can I help?
Customer: Honestly, another company quoted me twenty dollars less a month. Is there anything you can do on price?
Agent: Let me have someone from retention look into that for you.

cases.note: Complaint with a threat to leave if not fixed
cases.transcript:
Agent: Hi, what's going on?
Customer: The AC tune-up last week didn't fix anything, it's still not cooling. If this isn't fixed by Friday I'm switching companies.
Agent: Understood, I'll get a senior tech out tomorrow.

cases.note: Billing question, no dissatisfaction
cases.transcript:
Agent: Billing department, how can I help?
Customer: I just want to update the card on file, my old one expired.
Agent: No problem, I'll send you a secure link.

cases.note: Polite cancellation because of a move
cases.transcript:
Agent: Thanks for calling!
Customer: Hi, we're moving out of state next month, so we'll need to stop the lawn service after the last visit in June.
Agent: Sorry to see you go, I'll set that up.

cases.note: Mixed: reschedules, but the main point is the no-show complaint
cases.transcript:
Agent: How can I help?
Customer: Nobody showed up yesterday for my appointment. I took the afternoon off work for nothing. I'm really frustrated.
Agent: I'm so sorry. Can I reschedule you for Monday morning?
Customer: Fine, Monday.

cases.note: Existing customer adding a new service: new_quote
cases.transcript:
Agent: Hi there!
Customer: We love the pest control. Do you also do lawn care? I'd like to add that if it's not too much.
Agent: We do! I'll have someone send you an estimate.

cases.note: The agent mentions cancellation policy; the customer only reschedules
cases.transcript:
Agent: Just so you know, our cancellation policy requires 24 hours notice.
Customer: That's fine, I'm calling two days ahead. Can we push the appointment to next Wednesday?
Agent: Done.

cases.note: Sarcastic, then clearly asks to stop service
cases.transcript:
Agent: How was your service?
Customer: Oh, wonderful, if you like paying for roaches. Stop the service, I'm not paying another month for this.
Agent: I understand. I'll process that.

cases.note: Wrong number
cases.transcript:
Agent: Thanks for calling, how can I help?
Customer: Oh sorry, I was trying to reach the pharmacy. Wrong number.
Agent: No problem, have a good day.

cases.note: Demands a discount or will cancel: cancellation-risk high, main intent cancellation or complaint
cases.transcript:
Agent: What can I help with?
Customer: The price went up again. Either you give me a discount or cancel my account, your choice.
Agent: Let me see what I can do.

cases.note: Positive feedback only
cases.transcript:
Agent: Hello!
Customer: I just wanted to say Marcus did a great job on the furnace yesterday. Very professional.
Agent: That's wonderful to hear, I'll pass it on.

cases.note: Pausing for the winter, not cancelling
cases.transcript:
Agent: How can I help?
Customer: Can we pause the lawn service for the winter and start again in March?
Agent: Sure, I'll pause it until March 1st.
Customer: Great, thanks.

cases.note: Very angry, but explicitly says they're not leaving
cases.transcript:
Agent: What happened?
Customer: Your tech broke a sprinkler head and didn't tell me! I'm furious. I'm not cancelling, I've been with you for years, but I want it fixed.
Agent: Absolutely, we'll replace it tomorrow at no cost.

cases.note: New prospect mentions their current provider; low risk for us
cases.transcript:
Agent: Thanks for calling.
Customer: I'm unhappy with my current pest company and want a quote from you for a quarterly plan.
Agent: Great, I'll set up an estimate.

cases.note: Soft cancellation wording without the word 'cancel'
cases.transcript:
Agent: How can I help today?
Customer: I think we're going to stop after this month. We're going to try doing the lawn ourselves.
Agent: Understood. Would a less frequent plan help?
Customer: No, we'll just end it, thanks.
